# Proposed zero-record V3 State, Genesis and root corpus

This independent family pins all eight written specs and the independently approved exact-core Catalog corpus bytes. It imports no engine, runtime serializer, procedural generator or other fixture generator. Full six-gap coverage remains **Partial**; these Proposed fixtures do not authorize V3 code.

```sh
python3 docs/superpowers/specs/fixtures/living-v3-genesis-proposed/derive.py generate
python3 docs/superpowers/specs/fixtures/living-v3-genesis-proposed/derive.py verify
```

Only generate writes generatedvectors.json/coverage.json; verify reconstructs both outputs in memory and compares their exact bytes. Source/dependency drift rejects before derivation. Catalog approval is a separate external review in v3-catalog-corpus-rereview-1.md, not repeated or expanded here.

There are142 document cases: two principal zero-record positives, one full-width State header structural positive (not reached/replayed history), one explicitly unsupported populated State, and138 rejection documents. Additional diagnostics contain18 genesis-entity issuance leaf frames, one positive noncontiguous kind-local ordinal roster with three literal frames, eight root Branch negative records and ten top-level literal frames. Counts and proof limits are machine-readable in coverage.json.

The principal State has30 ordered fields: three canonical u64 header strings0,26 empty arrays including demand_requests, and counters `{}`. Its STATE hash uses the exact version3/catalog wrapper. Genesis has the declared ordered eight fields, explicit seed32/Generator, allocations[] and the complete State, with no self-integrity or branch field. G uses catalog_hash32/seed32/u32le-length-prefixed generator slug/u32le version. GENESIS and ROOT_BRANCH preimages include their exact NUL-terminated domains; root is truncated to16 bytes only after computing the full digest. Root Branch, HistoryView and high-water marks are exact diagnostic records for a genesis-only context. The queue is empty harness metadata, not an invented portable queue field. Sources: complete-schema §§Scalar grammar, Capacities and exact keys, Identity kind tags and sequence consumption, History archive Notebook and transfer schemas; wire §§Canonical state layout, Identity framing; v3-genesis-corpus-brief.md.

The State checker validates every required top-level field, order, array shape, canonical u64 width and empty counters. For the zero arrays, reference, global live-ID, ownership, reservation and graph predicates are vacuous, not silently bypassed populated predicates. Genesis additionally checks kind/version/catalog/seed/Generator, complete allocation shape, registered kind/positive ordinal/strict numeric keys, issuance frames/IDs and zero-manifest correspondence. No nonempty State row parser/admission claim is made: unsupported rows return outside_family, never a fabricated wire error. A general State with nonzero but valid header values is not rejected solely because this fixture starts0. Its shape-positive example explicitly disclaims replayed chronology. Genesis tick must be0; nonzero historical counter initialization is excluded as outside_family rather than an invented invalid-wire rule.

Allocation ordinals are positive unique within kind, not required contiguous. The diagnostic roster(kind1,ordinal1),(kind1,ordinal3),(kind2,ordinal1) has valid sorted keys and correctly framed IDs, but no corresponding live State and therefore is not an admitted Genesis. All18 kind frames likewise prove framing, not all-kind manifest/reservation/provenance admission. Simulated truncated SHA collisions are not claimed. Root negatives test declared root/null/genesis-state/revision/canonical-scalar conditions in the zero-history context; Branch/HistoryView/allocator diagnostic bytes are not standalone portable envelopes or admitted Archive.

Raw grammar witnesses preserve literal duplicate keys, alternate escape, floats/leading zeros, invalid UTF8/JSON, field order, whitespace/newline, depth65 and8388609-byte malformed input. Only raw cap-first byte_capacity is an exact asserted wire error. All other negatives use rejection-only plus local predicate paths, without imposing error precedence. Allocation rows added to an empty manifest may violate several checks; diagnostics retain those faults. Local decoder execution order is not a normative ordering. No own integrity field exists on State/Genesis: changed bytes change their digests; consumer bindings are separate checks.

The seed of32 zero bytes and fixture_minimal/version1 label are explicit fixture choices, not a product generator algorithm/default. Generator labels convey provenance and decoding never runs generator code. Inhabited initialization/paid SnapshotReference cycles, full Archive/history/scanner/high-water abandonment/queues, actor forecasts/scoring and production/platform/budget/cancellation proofs remain excluded. The8MiB+1 witness demonstrates this tool's cap-before-decode check; it is not production allocation or resident-preservation evidence. The malformed-input cases are sampled, not a general decoder qualification.
